description: Get live real-time price freshness metrics across OunceScout catalog: counts of verified listings under 4 hours, stale items, continuous verification cycle metrics, and IndexNow broadcast status. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).
name: get_market_freshness_index
title: Get Market Freshness Index
